chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hajjal, from Tha'labah, from Ma'mar ibn Yahya, who said:

I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام about a menstruating woman who becomes pure at the time of al-'Asr: does she pray the first one? He said: “No. She only prays the salat (prayer) whose time she becomes pure in.”

key_terms.الْأُولَى: the first prayer, meaning the earlier one
key_terms.تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَهَا: at whose time she becomes pure

ai.seo_question: If a menstruating woman becomes pure at the time of al-'Asr, must she also pray Zuhr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a menstruating woman who becomes tahir at the time of al-'Asr. Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام states that she is only required to perform the salat (prayer) whose time is current when she becomes pure, not the earlier prayer.
